items.quote: I'm giving the Pepsi to my neighbor. He's like, oh, thank you so much. And I'm saying, oh, don't worry.
items.statement: Providing help and value can condition a person to reciprocate or agree.

items.quote: he in his mind, he doesn't understand that he's conditioned to go ahead with his commitment.
items.statement: People are conditioned to follow through with commitments they perceive they have made.

items.quote: because one of the other rules of persuasion is commitment and consistency.
items.statement: One of the rules of persuasion involves the principle of commitment and consistency in social interactions.

overview: A discussion on psychological techniques used in persuasion, particularly commitment and consistency.
